Charlottesville, VA · Mountain bike

Wednesday Mountain Bike Ride (Endeavor Cycles) is a mountain bike group ride in Charlottesville, VA. It rolls every Wednesday at 5:30 pm from Endeavor Cycles. Pace: all skill levels.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: all skill levels.
Check
Look at @endeavor_cycles the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Wednesday Mountain Bike Ride (Endeavor Cycles) group ride

A midweek trail ride from the shop, usually on the O-Hill trails across the street. All skill levels. If you don't have a bike, the shop says to ask. The shop also runs a party-pace First Friday cruiser ride, about 5 miles.
